item.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are leaving police departments in the lurch
item.description: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

item.title: Yale Law expert on Hegseth's plans to livestream execution
item.description: Military justice expert Eugene Fidell of Yale Law School speaks to NPR about the Pentagon's plan to livestream the execution of a convicted mass murderer.

item.title: Tropical Storm Rachel downgraded as high winds and rain turn inward
item.description: Forecasters say the storm, which brought heavy rain and coastal flooding, is a preview of what may be in store as California braces for a possibly record-setting El Niño.

item.title: How Trump reshaped the DOJ's Civil Rights Division to serve his agenda
